}}'''Yuril''' is [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Tuon's]] [[Hand]] and the commander of all her [[Seekers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yuril|Yuril}} He also serves as her secretary.{{ref||Yuril}}

== Appearance ==
He is sharp nosed.

== Activities ==
He is part of the [[Corenne]] escorting Tuon personally.

He is present when Tuon warns King [[Beslan Mitsobar]] not to cause a revolt against the [[Seanchan]].
